decisions.reason: As a flagship product and given the firm's slack, it likely meets or exceeds aspirations, so management has no reason to search for alternatives.
Foldable large containers fit customer needs for cost-efficient return logistics and likely deliver satisfactory results, so keep.
Stackable plastic crates are a core standard product line with likely stable demand and satisfactory performance, so keep.
Medium-duty rackable pallets serve broad industrial and pooling customers and likely meet aspirations, so keep.
Spill-retention pallets address regulatory and environmental needs, and with organizational slack the firm can support this niche product while results remain acceptable.
Plastic pallets with load retainers complement existing pallet lines and likely benefit from slack while showing satisfactory results, so keep.
